hints.title: Rightward Span Until Smaller Element
hints.text: A subarray starting at index i remains valid as long as every subsequent element is greater than or equal to nums[i]. The segment extends until the next strictly smaller element.

hints.title: Monotonically Increasing Buffer
hints.text: Maintain an index list ordered with increasing values. When a newly inspected element is strictly smaller than prior indices, resolve their rightward limits.

hints.title: Subarray Count Summation
hints.text: If index i is closed by next smaller element at index R, it contributes R - i valid subarrays. Unclosed indices extend all the way to array end, contributing n - i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding from each index until finding a smaller element takes O(N^2) in descending arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A monotonic stack processes each index with at most one push and one pop, running in linear O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that finding the next smaller element is solved in O(N) using a monotonic stack.
complexity.notes: Every index is pushed and popped at most once.
